statement: The recorded “permitted” status is not safe or sufficiently reliable for publication because this is a post-1990 elephant-ivory item imported from Cameroon, requiring verified CITES and U.S. legal documentation.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts "The recorded 'permitted' status is not safe or sufficiently reliable" and names the specific problem (post-1990 elephant ivory imported from Cameroon lacking CITES/U.S. documentation).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
